2026_01_GB_MIN.headline: Green Bay’s line health is the pressure point in a Minnesota opener with little margin
2026_01_GB_MIN.paragraph1: Green Bay arrives in Minnesota with Warren Brinson out and multiple linemen listed as questionable, while the Vikings carry no final injury designations. In a divisional opener that has regularly produced tight games, that availability gap puts extra importance on the Packers staying ahead of the sticks and protecting the pocket without constant help. Minnesota can press that issue by changing fronts and forcing communication, while Green Bay needs enough early-down efficiency to keep the entire call sheet available.
2026_01_GB_MIN.model_rationale: Minnesota can test Green Bay’s protection depth with changing fronts, while the Packers need efficient early downs to avoid exposing their line on predictable passing situations.
